meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How FleetAi collects, uses and protects your personal data, in line with the GDPR.

hero.title: Privacy
hero.subtitle: We take the protection of your data seriously. This page explains what data we collect, why, and what your rights are.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: FleetAi is responsible for the processing of personal data collected through the platform and the public pages. For any question about this policy, you can contact us at the address shown at the bottom of this page.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: We only collect the data needed to run the service:
bullets: Account data: name, email address, organization and password (encrypted).
Fleet data: boats, equipment, maintenance history and documents you upload.
Usage data: pages viewed, actions performed and technical logs.
Billing data: subscription information processed through our payment provider.

sections.title: Why we use your data
sections.body: Your data is used for the following purposes:
bullets: Provide and maintain the fleet management service.
Generate AI-assisted cost estimates and maintenance recommendations.
Ensure support, security and continuous improvement of the platform.
Manage billing and comply with our legal obligations.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.body: We process your data on the basis of contract performance (providing the service), your consent (marketing communications), our legitimate interest (security and product improvement) and compliance with our legal obligations.

sections.title: Sharing and sub-processors
sections.body: We never sell your data. We rely on carefully selected sub-processors to operate the service:
bullets: Hosting and database within the European Union.
Cloudinary for storing and delivering documents and images.
Mistral AI for artificial intelligence features.
Stripe for payment processing.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.body: Your account data is kept for as long as your account is active. After it is closed, that data is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable timeframe, except where a legal retention obligation applies (billing, accounting). Data collected on our public pages is deleted automatically, every night, once the following periods have elapsed:
bullets: Messages sent through the contact form: 24 months after we receive them.
Contact details left on the cost simulator: 24 months after your latest simulation.
Estimate sharing links: 6 months after they are created, after which the link stops working.
Password reset links and unaccepted invitations: one week after they expire.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures: password encryption, secure connections (HTTPS), access control and regular backups.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights over your personal data:
bullets: Right to access your data.
Right to rectify inaccurate data.
Right to erasure (the "right to be forgotten").
Right to data portability.
Right to object to and restrict processing.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies that are strictly necessary for the platform to work (session, security) as well as anonymized analytics cookies. You can configure your browser to reject them.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this privacy policy to reflect legal or technical changes. The last updated date is shown at the top of this page.

contact.title: A question about your data?
contact.body: To exercise your rights or for any question about this policy, get in touch with us.
